title: Split advertised qualification gaps
requires: Current per-driver evidence index and capability-obligation review
scope: Reconcile every capability that production drivers currently advertise without a bound analytic or lifecycle contract. Bind an existing valid contract, stop advertising an unimplemented mode, or create a small family/mode-specific implementation card; do not hide gaps behind one aggregate qualification task.
acceptance: Publish a machine-readable matrix keyed by the complete capability tuple and classify every qualification-contract-is-missing result in the current evidence index.
For each gap, record the existing contract binding, the exact capability advertisement correction, or a new leaseable leaf task with one physical behavior and bounded acceptance checks.
Add every new leaf as an F5-99 dependency and regenerate the roadmap; this planning task does not itself qualify a capability or weaken an obligation.
evidence: PASS: source-pinned e51bc89 audit classified 393 report-level missing-contract results as 44 complete capability tuples and 76 tuple/scope gaps; all tuples retain passing execution evidence and 11 failed Windows CUDA occurrences remain explicit; docs/roadmap/evidence/F5-23-qualification-gap-matrix.json
PASS: 3/3 F5-23 matrix tests, roadmap validation across 209 task cards, and generated evidence-index check passed; 31 mode-specific leaves are F5-99 dependencies.
LIMITATION: F5-23 is planning-only and qualifies no capability; the full 28-test Windows roadmap suite retains three unrelated raw-CRLF hash failures in F6-07, F6-09 and F6-10.
